derivation: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H1995 (הָמוֹן); possessor of a multitude;

occurrences.text: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal–hamon; he let out the vineyard unto keepers; every one for the fruit thereof was to bring a thousand pieces of silver.
